verified_target: User-supplied Forge 6.2.0 source; also same declaration in strength-overhaul attachment
grokchess_runtime_compatibility: Unknown: no separately identified GrokChess NNUE loader or Engine NNUE interface is available.
architecture: shared 768 -> H per perspective; concat STM first, opponent second; 2H -> 1
feature_formula: ((piece.color == perspective ? 0 : 1) * 6 + piece.type - 1) * 64 + (perspective == White ? square : square XOR 56)
integration: Place exported include at src/nnue_weights.inc; build with FORGE_NNUE_HIDDEN equal to H (default 256 in Forge 6.2). Export marks standalone, not residual.

validation.platform: Linux, g++20, CPU training; not a Windows/DirectML hardware test
